objective: How long a twelve-step journey takes from queued to verdict
input: Ten executions of the same unedited test
expected: Ten passing runs, with their durations recorded
detail: queued to verdict: median 2048ms (min 2042ms, p95 2054ms, max 2054ms, n=10); in the browser: median 962ms (min 824ms, p95 1064ms, max 1064ms, n=10); platform overhead about 1086ms; about 80ms per step
